newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish March C/A surplus FIM 1.3 billion-Cen Bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish March C/A surplus FIM 1.3 billion-Cen Bank.

text.p: The Finnish current account surplus increased to 1.3 billion markka in March from a revised 0.6 billion surplus in February (revised from a 0.7 billion markka surplus), the Bank of Finland said on Tuesday.
It gave the following balance of payments figures (FIM bln):
(* The Bank of Finland said a negative figure marks an increase in reserves).

Finland's net foreign debt was 267.0 billion markka at end-March, down by 5.5 billion on end-February. The state's share of net foreign debt was 189.1 billion markka, down from 193.0 billion, the central bank said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
